verdicts.Typography: The type system underneath this is genuinely studio-grade — eight steps and no ninth, five declared leadings with nothing on `normal`, one tracking curve, a 31em measure calibrated in em so it self-scales, and the person's own words set identically at 17/1.62 in the field, the read body, the readback pieces and the hand card, which is the hardest thing in the discipline and is right — but two live composition defects stand in the way: the read plane's instruction is styled by a dead rule and outranks the note's own facts with a one-word widow at every desktop width, and the phone head breaks its date in half and centres the remainder at 360.

confirmed.element: 390x844 and 360x800, real touch. state=review and state=readback; .desk / .top / .handBody / .pieces
confirmed.problem: Only `notebook` has a phone branch (notebook.js:1884). Every other state renders into `.desk`, which master.css:1408 sets to `display:none` under 720px. Measured at 390 with hasTouch: a real tap on the visible 101x44 head chip [data-act="review"] enters review and .handBody measures 0x0; d-task, d-keep, d-later, d-delete and [data-act="notebook"] all measure 0x0 yet are still Tab-reachable — six invisible-but-focusable controls, and no visible way back (Escape needs a hardware keyboard; tapping an index row does nothing). A real tap on the dock's Dictate then on Stop and read it back is worse: the ink floor closes, .pieces, keep-both, discard-speech and add-piece all measure 0x0, .saidHead measures 0x0, the count still reads 14 notes, and the screen reader is told "2 notes came back. First: ... Edit either one, or keep both" while nothing about the spoken words is on screen. Dictation is the phone's headline capture route and it loses the words. The gate never enters voice or review below 1440; the assertion that is lying is the phone section's "the desk stands down and the index takes the screen" (notes-interaction-check.mjs:569), which asserts `.desk` is hidden as a virtue and thereby guarantees these rooms are invisible.
confirmed.fix: Build both phone branches; do NOT ship the fix's second clause. Disabling the Dictate glyph below 720px would amputate the phone's headline capture route, contradict the locked "dictating takes the whole floor to ink", and remove a control the 44px real-touch audit and the dock's suite-row composition both measure — that clause makes the work worse, and the ink floor already works correctly at 390 (voice-cancel 86x44, voice-stop 215x44), so only the readback panel is missing. Do it in two pieces. (1) READBACK: keep the .dark floor open through readback on the phone rather than closing it into a white sheet — the words came out of an ink room and the person is still inside it; render .saidHead, .pieces and the three acts into that same overlay, which already has the working focus trap at notebook.js:2462 and already sizes to 390x844. (2) REVIEW: reuse .phoneSheet as proposed, but note it is role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and it is rendered as `over:` on top of a live index — the hand is not the read sheet, and three closed findings live exactly on that seam. Also give both states a visible pointer exit; Escape is not a control on a phone. What must be re-measured after this lands, all at 390 and 360 with hasTouch: (a) hand-arrows-drive-the-index-behind and index-keyboard-dies-in-review-and-seam — arrow keys and T/K/L inside the sheet must not walk the index underneath it; (b) hand-peel-is-not-modal and every-act-rebuilds-the-world — the peel opened from inside a phoneSheet-hosted hand, and whether advancing a card annihilates scroll or focus in the index behind; (c) the notes-audit passes at these two widths for the new surfaces specifically — 44px real-touch targets on keep-both, discard-speech, add-piece, drop-piece and the four d-* verbs; the 32em measure ceiling and a declared leading on .saidHead, the pieceField textareas and the readBody (spoken-words-break-the-measure and transcript-at-display-leading both regress here first); (d) discard-speech-is-the-one-irreversible-act and voice-keep-both-announces-a-lie, since both acts now reach a thumb for the first time; (e) phone-dock-guillotines-the-index and phone-dock-clips-last-row — the .index bottom reserve of 128/148px must still clear the dock with the sheet open; (f) a zero-rect sweep asserting no focusable element in any state at 390 has a 0x0 rect, which is the assertion that would have caught this and does not exist. And extend the gate so every state, not just notebook, opens at 390 with hasTouch — the thirteen controls found here were invisible for as long as they were only ever opened at 1440.
